title: Summary of our Machine Learning Pipeline Architecture

cues.en: Now that we are basically done with our basic fraud detection system, let's have a summary of how our machine learning pipeline architecture works in practice.
cues.zh: 基本的詐欺偵測系統已經完成，接著總結機器學習流程架構在實際情境如何運作。

cues.en: So first a customer initiates a transaction.
cues.zh: 首先，客戶發起交易。

cues.en: Then the transaction is processed and stored in the database.
cues.zh: 交易經過處理並儲存到資料庫。

cues.en: Then our machine learning pipeline extracts features from the transaction.
cues.zh: 機器學習流程從交易擷取特徵。

cues.en: Then the deployed model scores the transaction for fraud risk.
cues.zh: 已部署的模型評估交易的詐欺風險分數。

cues.en: If the risk score exceeds the thresholds then the transaction is flagged.
cues.zh: 風險分數超過門檻時，交易就會被標記。

cues.en: Then a staff reviews the flagged transactions and then confirms or denies the fraud.
cues.zh: 再由員工審核被標記的交易，確認是否為詐欺。

cues.en: The confirmed cases of feedback into the training data.
cues.zh: 已確認的案例會回饋到訓練資料。

cues.en: Then the models are periodically retrained with new data.
cues.zh: 模型會定期以新資料重新訓練。

cues.en: And lastly, the better performing models are deployed to production.
cues.zh: 最後，把表現更好的模型部署到正式環境。

cues.en: And our system offers two ways to deploy better performing models.
cues.zh: 系統提供兩種方式部署表現較好的模型。

cues.en: One, these are manual deployment, where a superadmin can select a specific model by the ID and deploy it using API v1 ml deploy endpoint like I had shown before.
cues.zh: 第一是手動部署，超級管理員可以依 ID 選取特定模型，透過先前展示的 /api/v1/ml/deploy 端點部署。

cues.en: Then there's the auto deployment, where the system can automatically find and deploy the best performing
cues.zh: 第二是自動部署，系統會自動尋找並部署表現最好，

cues.en: model that exceeds the performance threshold using the API v1 ml auto deploy endpoint passing in the threshold as a query parameter.
cues.zh: 而且超過效能門檻的模型，透過 /api/v1/ml/auto-deploy，將門檻當作查詢參數傳入。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And I think we are now officially done with the basic features that we needed for our banking API and machine learning functionality.
cues.zh: 銀行 API 與機器學習功能所需的基本功能，現在正式完成了。

cues.en: Please feel free to extend the functionality of this API.
cues.zh: 歡迎自行擴充這個 API 的功能。

cues.en: In the last section of this course, we shall now be deploying our API to a virtual Private server.
cues.zh: 課程最後一章會把 API 部署到虛擬私人伺服器。

cues.en: But before we can do that, let's go to our terminal.
cues.zh: 在此之前，先到終端機。

cues.en: Then we can bring our containers down, including the volumes.
cues.zh: 停止容器，並移除磁碟區。

cues.en: Then we can also deactivate the virtual environment.
cues.zh: 再停用虛擬環境。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: That's it for this lecture and this section.
cues.zh: 這堂課與這一章就到這裡。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next section where we deploy our API.
cues.zh: 下一章會部署 API，到時見。
